references.text: The Lord promised to drive out the nations little by little, not in one year, so that the land would not become desolate and wild animals multiply too much.
The Lord sends hornets ahead of Israel to drive out the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites.
The Lord also sends hornets against the enemies of those who hide until they are destroyed.
Joshua warns that if Israel turns away from the Lord, he will no longer drive these nations out of their land.
A warning that the remaining inhabitants of the land will become thorns in your eyes and pricks in your sides.
The Lord promises to drive out the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
The Lord decides not to drive out any more nations, to test whether Israel will follow his ways.
